Definition: from G2095 and a derivative of G5087; well placed, i.e. (figuratively) appropriate:--fit, meet.
BiblicalUsage: eúthetos is a plain word for fit, meet. In Luke 9:62, the text says "is fit for the kingdom of God." In Luke 14:35, the text says "It is neither fit for the land."
TheologicalSignificance: What eúthetos teaches me is that serving is not earning; it is answering love with love. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
